ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (21) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Pronouns for Christ and God stay lowercase, and «отец всех» (otets vsekh, 'the father of all') is lowercase as printed; Lamennais's «предсказание» (predskazanie, 'prediction') is repeated as in the source, where the website draft varied it to 'prophecy'. Channing's «На земле мир и в людях благоволение» (Na zemle mir i v lyudyakh blagovoleniye) is translated from the Russian, not from an English Bible.

Source observation: [5] «последней борьбы зла с добром, которая готова уже возродиться» (poslednei bor'by zla s dobrom, kotoraya gotova uzhe vozrodit'sya, 'the last struggle… ready to be reborn'): «возродиться» may be a slip for «разразиться» (razrazit'sya, 'break out'); translated as printed.
Source observation: [5] «учениями, делающими братьев чужими и сеющих» (ucheniyami, delayushchimi… i seyushchikh): case slip, «сеющих» for «сеющими» ('sowing'); the evident sense is translated.
